contract: The RPC/SSPI context permits local impersonation for the verified W32Time service. The pipe retains identification-only access.
Packet privacy, replay and sequence protection, bounded replies, peer checks, and cancellation remain required. Delegation and anonymous authentication remain refused.
Production code enables no privilege and changes no time setting. The required native preflight and full runtime gates remain unchanged.
